extra-uruguay-punta-del-este.name: Jabad Punta del Este
extra-uruguay-punta-del-este.note: Beit Jabad Uruguay's own magazine (Kesher, Pesach 5770, 2010): 'También este año Beit Jabad dijo "presente" en Punta del Este ... los servicios de Shabat dirigidos por el Rabino Shemtov en la sinagoga de la calle Montevideo (Parada 13 ½)', and 'En ocasión de la 25 temporada de Jabad de Punta' a Tanya was printed 'en la oficina del Beit Jabad de Punta' on Sunday 10 Jan 2010 (24 Teves 5770). The summer of 2009-10 being its 25th season, the first was the summer of 1985-86, Rabbi Eliezer Shemtov's first in Uruguay (he came in 1985; Chabadpedia: married in 5744, then went to Uruguay): December 1985 to March 1986 is all within 5746. High: the center's own count of its seasons. Its synagogue is Ajdut Israel (founded by Matiu Eisenberg), run by Beit Jabad. 'Chabad-Lubavitch Rabbi Eliezer Shemtov welcomes thousands of Jews to the resort town of Punta del Este every summer' (Chabad.org, 6 July 2011, https://www.chabad.org/article.asp?aid=1564398).

people.name: Rabbi Eliezer Shemtov
people.note: leads the Punta del Este seasons (Kesher 2010; Chabad.org 2011)
